summary: Field by field: ψ⁺(0) = 1; the step property by Fubini over the finite product, with the bounds multiplied; positivity by the Schur product theorem; continuity of products; the two norm bounds by multiplying the factor bounds.

steps.claim: ψ⁺(0) = (∏_v wave(0))·ψ(0) = 1, since wave(0) = 1 and ψ(0) = 1 (field psi_zero of K). In the remaining fields, a unit of (τ → ℂ) × C is a family of units in every component, and products over v and the C-factor are regrouped; their hypotheses are introduced.
steps.lean:
use (by simp [K.1, wave]) <;> (try simp only [Pi.isUnit_iff, Prod.isUnit_iff, comp_update,
    ← prod_mul_distrib, mul_mul_mul_comm _ _ (∏ _, _), and_imp]) <;> intros

steps.claim: For each v the step property of H_v gives integrability of its function (A), its integral at frequency 0 (B) and its bound at unit frequencies (C); likewise the step property of K gives a, b, c.
steps.lean:
choose A B C using (H · |>.step)
  choose a b c using K.step

steps.claim: The step property of the product: the function c ↦ ψ⁺(ξc)·J⁺_{i+1}(p[i ↦ u⁺(c)], q[i ↦ u⁺(c)]) is the product of the integrable functions of the factors in independent variables, hence integrable; by Fubini its integral is the product of the factor integrals, which is J⁺_i(p, q) at ξ = 0 and, at a unit ξ, has absolute value at most the product of the factor bounds, that is β⁺(ξ)·Λ⁺_i(p)·Λ⁺_i(q).
steps.lean:
use .mul_prod (.fintype_prod (by tauto)) (a _ _ _ _ ‹_›), ?_, fun _ _ ↦ .trans ?_
    (norm_mul_le_of_le (by grw [← C, ← norm_prod] <;> tauto) (by tauto)) <;> simp +contextual [*,
    -integral_const_mul, ← B, ← b, ← integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod, ← integral_prod_mul] <;> tauto

steps.claim: Positive semidefiniteness: for a family a with common entry t at n, the matrix (J⁺_{n+1}(a_k, a_l)) is the entrywise (Hadamard) product of the matrices of the factors H_v and K, each positive semidefinite; by induction over the finite set of v and the Schur product theorem it is positive semidefinite.
steps.lean:
next t e => exact univ.induction (by simp [K.3, e]) (fun v _ _ ↦ by
    simpa [mul_assoc, *] using! ((H v).3 _ (t.1 v) (by simp [e])).hadamard)

steps.claim: Continuity: J⁺_{n+1} is a product of the continuous functions J'_{v,n+1} and J_{n+1} composed with continuous projections, hence continuous.

The two norm bounds (|J⁺_0| ≤ En⁺ and the off-diagonal bound) follow by multiplying the corresponding bounds of the factors: the norm of a product is at most the product of the norms, and products of nonnegative bounds are monotone.
